ModMetaData.name: Project Mamono Insects
ModMetaData.author: Gapho
ModMetaData.description:
Turns the six insectoids of the Rim into insect mamonos, who live in insector tribes of their own.
Megascarabs, spelopedes and megaspiders - and, with the Odyssey expansion, larvae, locusts and hive queens - have monster girl counterparts: devil bugs, giant ants, soldier beetles, greenworms, vamp mosquitoes and abaddons. Vanilla insects still spawn and fight as they always did.
The mamonos live in villages raised from hive walls and creep. One tribe is neutral and can be befriended, and one is always at war.
The bug girls keep mostly the exact stats of the insects they replace - the same chitin armor, health, speed, cold-blooded comfort ranges and toxin immunity, and the same mandibles and claws.
Requires the Biotech expansion, Harmony, Big and Small - Framework, Project Mamono, Vanilla Expanded Framework, Vanilla Races Expanded - Insector, and Vanilla Factions Expanded - Insectoids 2. The Odyssey expansion is optional: with it larvae, locusts and hive queens are also transformed; without it only the three base-game insectoids have mamonos.
